title: StudioBrain Entity Base Schema
description: Shared YAML frontmatter fields required by every StudioBrain entity.

id.description: Unique snake_case entity identifier matching the folder name.

entity_type.description: Entity type discriminator: a lowercase slug. Users define their own types (SBAI-15043), so this is open; per-type schemas pin it with const.

template_version.description: Semantic version of the template used (e.g. "1.0" or "2.0").

editable.description: Whether the entity can be edited via the UI.

marketplace_eligible.description: Whether the entity can be published to the marketplace.

folder_name.description: The folder that stores this entity type (e.g. "Characters").

associated_rules.description: Rule files governing this entity type.

primary_image.description: Path to the entity's primary image.

views.description: Template-level browse views, shared with teammates through template sync (SBAI-15043). Reserved meta key: never derived as an entity field.

grid_fields.description: Legacy card fields. Read as views.roles.card_fields. Reserved meta key.

list_layout.description: Legacy name for views; read as views. Reserved meta key.

entityTypeSlug.description: Entity type id: a lowercase letter or digit first, then lowercase letters, digits and underscores (e.g. character, vehicle, star_system, 3d_level). A leading digit is allowed because the shipped 3D Level map type is 3d_level and existing maps store that id as their entity_type and template_id; renaming it would orphan them.

templateCategory.description: Template category: decides rendering (form, rich editor, map renderer, rule, skill) and the default browse views.
